declaration.negotiation_history_statement: The settlement was reached through arm’s-length negotiations between class counsel and Brightline’s counsel over multiple rounds. The parties negotiated the class relief and attorneys’ fees as separate components of a complete settlement package. The agreement provides a $34 million class fund, automatic distribution to identified class members, and a separately stated $6 million fee request subject to court approval. Brightline does not agree to clear sailing, and any fee amount not awarded will not revert to Brightline. Consistent with the confidentiality of the negotiations, this statement does not disclose confidential negotiation communications or offers.
